name: Headphones
summary: Over-ear headphones with padded headband and cushions, resting on their cups; anim beat pulses the cups to music.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cups rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the headphones are about 460 px wide and 430 px tall (hand-held size)

params.name: anim
params.note: beat = the cups swell gently to a rhythm
